rationale: Caliche Development Partners III, LLC is the current manager-level U.S. underground-storage platform. Sixth Street holds majority equity through Mallard Evergreen Holdings, wholly owned by Sixth Street TAO Partners and parallel vehicles, while Caliche Management III retains minority equity and operational leadership. The Texas perimeter closed in October 2024 and CVGS closed on March 18, 2025. GTS, CVGS, carbon-sequestration projects and legal SPVs remain subordinate to one canonical platform.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Caliche Development Partners company record using Caliche Development Partners III, LLC as the current operator/legal iteration.
Record Sixth Street as majority current owner from October 2024 through Mallard Evergreen Holdings, with Sixth Street TAO Partners, L.P. and parallel vehicles.
Record Caliche Management III as the retained minority current owner from October 2024.
Preserve Energy Spectrum VII, Orion Infrastructure Capital, GCM Grosvenor/TDIP and Caliche Management II as former ownership history with date precision and disclosure caveats.
Do not create separate PortCos for GTS, CVGS, the carbon-sequestration project or underlying SPVs; do not treat MUFG or other lenders as owners.
